## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

From 9 am – 2 pm E.T. today, share with us your responses online to these three questions -- "What do you notice?",  "What do you wonder?", and “What impact does this topic have on you and your community?”

Note that you can get a link to your response to share with your teacher and classmates by clicking the response box below your response “Email me when my comment is published.”  

Keep noticing and wondering.  Stay tuned for next week’s graph about the speeds of the fastest women runners.

## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

raw_comment:
We notice the East half of the country has more cases than the West half, and that large population centers and the Southeast have a lot of cases. We noticed the numbers under the state names in the first graph. These seem to be the number of cases in that state. We noticed the first map showed total cases, and the second map showed per capita cases. The darker colors on the first map are overlapping circles, whereas darker colors on the second map represent higher case counts. Places on the first map with really big circles are not always the darkest color on the second map. 

We wonder why the East has more cases. We wonder about the number of deaths per county (or parish, as we call them here in Louisiana). We wonder when this will end, if the rates will go down, and when there will be a vaccine. We wonder what these maps will look like in three months, and what they would have looked like three months ago. 

This data affects our community because not having large social gatherings is making some people lonely and bored. We appreciate that our region’s per capita rate is lower than other parts of the state and the country. The southern part of Louisiana (we are in the northwest corner) is one of the larger red regions on the Per Capita map. We wonder how much Mardi Gras played a role in that. 

Headlines: 
What's Going On With the East Side?
Big Cities Have Trouble Slowing the Spread of COVID 19
IN THE RED: A LOOK AT HOW COVID-19 IS AFFECTING DIFFERENT US STATES

image_description:
## 1. Chart type
- **Top:** Proportional symbol map / **bubble map** of U.S. counties.
- **Bottom:** **Choropleth map** of U.S. counties.

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |
| Total number of Covid cases by county in 2020 | Quantitative | Circle size/area in the top map |
| Per capita Covid cases by county in 2020 (share of population with a reported case) | Quantitative | Color/hue of county areas in the bottom map |
| County | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Individual map marks/regions (one circle or one county polygon per county) |
| State names / selected place names | Categorical/nominal | Text labels on the map |
| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |

- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked map panels** (small multiples by metric).
- No faceting by category within each panel.
- No stacking of marks.
- Top panel overlays **circles on a geographic basemap**; bottom panel fills **county polygons** by color.

| County geographic location | Spatial/geographic | Position on map (latitude/longitude) |

| No cases reported | Categorical/nominal | Light gray fill in the choropleth legend/map |
